en.title: Shield AI rolls out X-BAT 001, its autonomous tail-sitting fighter
en.summary: Shield AI has offered a first look at X-BAT 001, believed to be the first flight-test vehicle for its autonomous, tail-sitting fighter aircraft, revealing broad wings, digital camouflage and a prominent engine exhaust.
body: A short video shows the aircraft inside a hangar, revealing its broad wings, grey digital camouflage and prominent engine exhaust. The aircraft wears markings reading X-BAT 001 and Powered by Hivemind, identifying the vehicle and the autonomy software intended to fly it. Its sharply swept wings blend into a substantial central body, with no cockpit or canopy, and panel boundaries and fasteners are visible in closer views, alongside a broad, mouth-like opening beneath the forward body that appears to form the aircraft's intake.

Despite being designed to take off and land vertically from a tail-sitting position, X-BAT 001 is shown resting horizontally on ground supports, and Shield AI has not explained that presentation; the footage does not show the aircraft being raised into its launch position or demonstrate its landing arrangement. The video gives particular attention to the rear, including close-ups of a circular exhaust nozzle with overlapping metallic petals, an assembly that appears consistent with the GE F110 propulsion system selected for X-BAT: the F110-GE-129E combined with GE's Axisymmetric Vectoring Exhaust Nozzle, or AVEN, which redirects engine thrust to provide the control needed for vertical flight. In July, the companies announced successful integration, actuation and engine light-off testing at GE's Peebles facility in Ohio. Shield AI's latest published schedule calls for flight testing to begin before the end of 2026, and its October update said flight-test aircraft were under construction and weapons-bay aerodynamics had been evaluated in low- and high-speed wind-tunnel tests. Aerospace Global News has asked Shield AI to confirm the vehicle's status and configuration and is awaiting comment.

zh.title: ShieldAI公開自主尾坐式戰機X-BAT001首架試飛載具
zh.summary: ShieldAI公開X-BAT001短片，據信為其自主尾坐式戰機的首架試飛載具；影片顯示寬大機翼、數位迷彩與醒目尾噴口，但ShieldAI尚未說明該機為何以水平姿態展示，也未證實其狀態與構型。
body: ShieldAI公開一段短片，首度展示X-BAT001，外界認為這是其自主尾坐式戰機的首架試飛載具。影片中的飛機位於機庫內，具備寬大機翼、灰色數位迷彩與醒目的引擎尾噴口，機身標示「X-BAT001」與Hivemind字樣，顯示將由Hivemind自主軟體駕駛。該機機翼大幅後掠並融入寬大的中央機身，沒有座艙或座艙罩，前機身下方還有一處寬大的口狀開口，看似為進氣口。

值得注意的是，X-BAT設計上應以尾坐姿態垂直起降，但影片中的X-BAT001卻以水平姿態置於地面支架上，ShieldAI並未說明此一展示方式，影片也未顯示該機被豎起至發射姿態或展示其著陸裝置。尾部特寫的圓形噴嘴具有重疊金屬瓣片，與X-BAT選用的GEF110推進系統相符，F110-GE-129E引擎搭配GE的軸對稱向量噴嘴AVEN，可改變推力方向以提供垂直飛行所需的控制；今年7月，雙方已在GE俄亥俄州Peebles設施完成整合、作動與引擎點火測試。ShieldAI最新公布的時程要求在2026年底前展開飛行測試，10月更新也指出試飛載具正在建造中，武器艙氣動力已完成低速與高速風洞測試；但報導單位已向ShieldAI詢問該機狀態與構型，目前仍在等待回覆。
